summary: Updated isDangerousRm() to parse short and long rm flags separately: short flags still use character matching, while long options require exact --recursive/--force matches, eliminating false positives like --verbose. Added regression coverage for --recursive --force, --verbose --force, -rf, -r -f, and mixed --recursive -f forms in src/goal/hard-deny.test.ts. Verification passed: pnpm vitest run src/goal/hard-deny.test.ts, pnpm build, pnpm lint.
